classification.reason: The repository already contains a 13-observable DESI DR2 BAO comparison setup and result, so treating all DESI DR2 work as absent is stale. What remains unclosed is reproduction of the official joint/cross-block likelihood products and reference-model tolerances.

scientific_boundary: The existing local 13-observable result is a real project result but is not promoted to an official DESI joint likelihood reproduction. The current local setup favors LCDM over RLL, and that negative result is preserved.
F_ok: A 13-observable DESI DR2 BAO comparison exists in the repository.
The local setup records a negative RLL-vs-LCDM result rather than hiding it.
The audit explicitly separates local/block construction from official joint/cross-block reproduction.
F_next: Materialize immutable official DESI DR2 joint/cross-block products or likelihood release.
Reproduce official LCDM and CPL reference outputs within declared tolerance before interpreting RLL deltas.
